Cost-bearing and network resources remain opt-in.
Public network access is disabled by default.
Optional internal app revision uses workload identity, Key Vault reference, and probes.
Unsafe image, network, and secret combinations cannot create the application or managed services.
Private endpoint, DNS, and delegated PostgreSQL network contracts are declared.
ADLS Gen2 uses OAuth-first access, versioning, and soft-delete retention.
A user-assigned workload identity receives scoped data-plane roles.
Engineering event queue enables duplicate detection and dead lettering.
Budget and operational alerts require an explicit engineering contact.
PostgreSQL declares retention, optional geo-backup, and storage autogrow.
PostgreSQL password is a secure deployment parameter, not a committed value.
Template outputs preserve the project claim boundary.
The checked-in template compiles with the available Bicep CLI.

service_decisions.azure_container_apps: optional internal API revision with managed identity, Key Vault reference, and health probes
service_decisions.adls_gen2: curated non-patient bronze/silver/gold/quarantine target with versioning and soft delete
service_decisions.azure_ai_search: optional Entra/RBAC, private-endpoint hybrid-search shadow candidate
service_decisions.service_bus: optional engineering events with duplicate detection and dead lettering
service_decisions.postgres_flexible_server: optional private delegated-subnet database with 14-day default backup retention
service_decisions.key_vault: RBAC secret boundary with private endpoint contract and purge protection
service_decisions.log_analytics: central engineering logs; public ingestion/query disabled by default
service_decisions.managed_identity: user-assigned workload identity with scoped storage, vault, search, and messaging roles
service_decisions.cost_management: optional 80% actual and 100% forecast budget notifications
service_decisions.alerts: optional failed control-plane operation alert to an engineering address
service_decisions.data_factory_or_databricks: not justified at current volume; local incremental pipeline remains canonical
service_decisions.azure_managed_redis: not provisioned; existing cache abstraction remains replaceable

known_blockers: No authenticated Azure CLI or subscription what-if is available on this machine.
No Azure resource has been deployed and no cost-bearing service has been enabled.
Private connectivity has not been exercised from a deployed workload.
Container application and Key Vault references are defined but not deployed.
Private Log Analytics ingestion requires an Azure Monitor Private Link design before a private deployment.
PostgreSQL point-in-time restore and regional recovery remain unproven.
Azure AI Search index provisioning and frozen shadow retrieval comparison remain incomplete.
No measured cloud load, reliability, security, or cost evidence exists.
claim_boundary: This artifact compiles and inspects a local Azure reference template only. It is not evidence of a successful cloud deployment, security certification, HIPAA compliance, clinical validation, or production healthcare readiness.
